column1: # Every declaration in THIS project, one per line, sorted by name.
# GENERATED — do not edit. Regenerate with `make index`.
# Zero because nothing is formalized yet. `tools/decl_index.lean` indexes the
# modules it imports, and its `import Decoupled.…` lines are commented out until
# those modules exist. Uncomment them with the first statements.
# Fields, tab-separated: kind, name, file:line, conclusion, hypotheses.
# Hypotheses are ` | `-separated; for a theorem they are its propositional binders,
# for a def its whole signature.
# Dropped, because every declaration carries the same ones and they bury the rest:
# instance binders, bare type variables, and the schedule. The `Decoupled.` and
# `Framework.StsMultisetLog.` prefixes are stripped. So a row is a search key, not a
# statement you can paste into Lean.
# Looking for a lemma whose *statement* you know but whose name you do not? Prefer
# `exact?` on the goal — it matches up to unification, which grep cannot.
# An earlier formalization of the same paper has its own index of 975 declarations.
# It is not in this repository; REFERENCES_LOCAL.md says where to read it.
